BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_REDIS_URL.prompt: Redis URL — required when store=redis (e.g. redis://localhost:6379/0)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_FILE.prompt: Path to the registry JSON file (used when store=file)

BLUE_DATA_SOURCES_CONFIG.prompt: Path to the sources config JSON file

BLUE_DATA_SOURCES_SYNC.prompt: Sync sources on startup when BLUE_DATA_SOURCES_CONFIG is set

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_METADATA_LLM_MODEL.prompt: LLM model for `blue-registry source metadata` (overrides BLUE_DATA_LLM_MODEL)

BLUE_DATA_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.prompt: Embedding provider for vector search (openai; blank = keyword-only)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_VECTOR_SOURCE.prompt: Vector store: memory, file, or redis (blank = match the registry store)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_VECTOR_DIR.prompt: Directory for file vectors (default: next to the registry file)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_VECTOR_SCAN_PREFIX.prompt: Redis key prefix for vectors when vector store=redis (default: blue_data_vec:)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_VECTOR_DIM.prompt: Embedding vector dimensions (must match the embedding model)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_SEARCH_BM25_WEIGHT.prompt: BM25 score weight in hybrid search (0.0–1.0)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_SEARCH_VECTOR_WEIGHT.prompt: Vector score weight in hybrid search (0.0–1.0)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_SEARCH_VALUE_WEIGHT.prompt: Value score weight in hybrid search (0.0–1.0)

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_SEARCH_BM25_THRESHOLD.prompt: Minimum BM25 score to include a result

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_SEARCH_VECTOR_THRESHO.prompt: Minimum vector score to include a result

BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_SEARCH_COMBINED_THRES.prompt: Minimum combined score to include a result
